tasks.title: Validate the four gateway keys in the [sandbox] config
steps: Write TS-27-1..TS-27-7 against internal/sandboxes (read config.go and validate.go from spec 25 first) and confirm they fail

Add Listen, TLSCert, TLSKey, ExternalURL fields to Config with TOML keys listen, tls_cert, tls_key, external_url; register them as known keys so Undecoded() filtering does not report them; expand ${NAME} like other strings; default Listen to "127.0.0.1:8443"
Add an unexported isLoopback(addr) helper: net.SplitHostPort, host == "localhost" or net.ParseIP(host).IsLoopback(); no DNS lookup; empty host, 0.0.0.0, :: and other hostnames are not loopback

In Validate, add failures (appended to the same errors.Join collection) naming sandbox.listen for bad split or non-numeric/out-of-range port (0..65535 accepted), sandbox.tls_key/sandbox.tls_cert for a single-sided pair, sandbox.listen with the word loopback for non-loopback without TLS, sandbox.external_url when non-loopback and empty
Validate external_url when set: url.Parse, scheme http or https, non-empty host, no userinfo, no query, no fragment, path empty or "/"; failures name sandbox.external_url
Expose the validated Listen, TLSCert, TLSKey, ExternalURL on the Validated struct so startup can use them

tasks.title: Add the scrubber and conditional lease state transitions with error and end_reason
steps: Write TS-27-54, TS-27-55 (property test with generated texts, values across the 1024-byte boundary, multi-byte runes at the cut) and TS-27-38 and confirm they fail

Create internal/sandboxes/scrub.go: copy carrypatch's userinfo pattern `(?i)([a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*://)[^/\s?#]*@` locally (do not import carrypatch); scrub(text string, values []string) replaces every non-empty value with [redacted] (longest first), removes userinfo with ${1}, then truncates to 1024 bytes on a UTF-8 boundary, re-checking that no value survives

Read spec 26's lease store; check whether sandbox_leases has error and end_reason columns. If not, add an idempotent migration in the style of jobqueue.MigrateProgress (PRAGMA table_info guard, then ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN); note the lease column is end_reason, carrying client|api, not a separate destroy_reason

Add lease store transition methods, each a single UPDATE conditioned on `state = ?` returning rows affected: leased→active (sets sandbox_id), leased→failed (sets error, ended_at, clears token hash), leased→destroyed and active→destroyed (set end_reason, ended_at, clear token hash); no transition can start from destroyed, failed or expired
Make the lease read type expose Error and EndReason and the JSON lease representation include error and end_reason (nullable)

tasks.title: Implement the lease authenticator for gatewayd
steps: Write TS-27-16, TS-27-17 and TS-27-19 (captured slog via swapping slog.Default, store seam returning a non-not-found error) and confirm they fail
Create internal/sandboxes/gateway_auth.go with a constructor returning func(ctx, token string) (string, bool), using spec 26's token hash + lookup function and the injected now func
Accept only a lease in leased or active whose expires_at is strictly after now; return the lease id as principal; refuse empty, malformed, unknown, terminal and expired tokens with ("", false)
No cache: read the store on every call
On a store error other than not-found, log slog.Error with the error but never the token or its SHA-256, and refuse; never log either on any path

tasks.title: Build hub's spec in the wrapping backend's Create
steps: Write TS-27-20..TS-27-27 with a recording sandbox.Provider double and in-memory SQLite lease store, and confirm they fail

Create internal/sandboxes/backend.go: type Backend implementing sandbox.Provider, holding the provider, profiles, network_modes, lease store, secrets store, emitter, now func, a principal func defaulting to gatewayd.PrincipalFromContext, and a claims set guarded by a mutex

Create(ctx, spec): read principal (no principal → error before any lease load or provider call); claim the lease id (already claimed → FailedPrecondition), release via defer; load lease; state != leased → FailedPrecondition naming the state; expires_at <= now → FailedPrecondition containing "expired" with no state change

Look up the lease's profile in the in-memory profiles; if missing mark the lease failed through the leased→failed transition with a message naming the profile, and return FailedPrecondition with that message (event emission is wired in the events task; leave an emit hook method here)

Add buildSpec: Image, Network, Resources, required secret names from the lease; fixed env, optional secret names, require_landlock and unrecorded resource fields from the profile; TTL = (expires_at-now) truncated to whole seconds; Workdir from caller; labels = caller labels minus keys starting hub., plus hub.<k> per lease label, then hub.lease and hub.workspace last; ignore caller image, env, network, resources, TTL, landlock
Call the provider's Create with the built spec (secret resolution is added in the next task); use google.golang.org/grpc status codes for FailedPrecondition

tasks.title: Resolve secrets at Create and record Create outcomes
steps: Write TS-27-28..TS-27-37 using a real secrets.Store on in-memory SQLite (workspaces, orgs, org_members tables plus secrets.InitSchema) and confirm they fail

Create internal/sandboxes/secret_resolve.go: build the tier chain with spec 26's chain helper (workspace slug; org workspaces.org_id only when set and the owner is a member of it; user workspaces.owner_id); call GetSecretValue tier by tier, first hit wins, *secrets.NotFoundError (errors.As) moves on

Required name in no tier: leased→failed with error `secret_missing: <key> ... scopes searched: workspace, org, user`, FailedPrecondition with the same text, provider not called; optional miss is skipped; any other store error returns gRPC Internal, lease stays leased, claim released
Set Env to profile fixed env plus resolved values under the profile's spelling of the name; keep values only in memory, never persisted

On provider Create success run the conditional leased→active update setting sandbox_id = box ID(); if it affects zero rows, destroy the new box on the provider, slog.Warn with lease id and sandbox id, return FailedPrecondition naming the re-read state, emit nothing
On provider Create error: scrub the message with scrub() over resolved secret values and non-empty fixed env values, run leased→failed storing the scrubbed text, return the scrubbed error

Wire the lease emit hook to emit hub.sandbox.create (lease_id, sandbox_id, image, network) on success and hub.sandbox.failed (lease_id, error) on every failure path (missing profile, missing secret, provider error) — one event each; wrap the returned box in a handle type (delegating methods; Spec and Close are completed in the next task)

tasks.title: Implement the rest of the backend: capabilities, list, destroy and the handle
steps: Write TS-27-41..TS-27-47 (TS-27-43 over a real in-process gatewayd.Server on 127.0.0.1:0 with the real gateway.Dial client) and confirm they fail
Capabilities(): provider capabilities with NetworkModes intersected with network_modes
List(ctx): with a principal return at most the one provider box whose ID equals the lease's sandbox_id (empty for a leased lease); without a principal return the provider's list

Destroy(ctx, id): with a principal, require lease.sandbox_id == id else return a gRPC NotFound without touching the provider; call provider Destroy; errors.Is(err, sandbox.ErrNotFound) counts as success; other errors are returned scrubbed and the lease stays active
On success run active→destroyed with end_reason client and emit hub.sandbox.destroy (lease_id, sandbox_id, reason "client") via the shared emit helper

Make the Create-returned handle's Close() call the same client destroy path; Spec() returns the built spec with every Env value replaced by "[redacted]"; Reap passes straight through to the provider; every other handle method delegates to the provider's sandbox with unchanged arguments

tasks.title: Start the gateway: bind, TLS load, gatewayd.Server, gateway_url and main wiring
steps: Write TS-27-8..TS-27-14 using seams for gatewayd.New, the exit function and the serve function, and confirm they fail
Create internal/sandboxes/gateway.go with StartGateway(svc, deps, seams): when svc is nil bind nothing and build no server
When TLS is configured load tls.LoadX509KeyPair; on failure return an error naming sandbox.tls_cert and sandbox.tls_key and including the loader's error, before binding anything
net.Listen on listen; a failure returns an error naming sandbox.listen with the bind error

Build gatewayd.Config{Backend: the wrapping backend, Authenticate: lease authenticator, TLS, NetworkModes, MaxSandboxes, MaxTTL} with no Tokens; if gatewayd.New fails close the listener and return the wrapped error

Compute the gateway URL: external_url when set, else https:// when TLS or http:// otherwise plus the listener's bound address (port 0 resolves to the real port); store it on the service for the lease handlers
Serve on the bound listener in a goroutine; if Serve returns, slog.Error the error and call the injected exit function with a non-zero code (os.Exit(1) in production); never call Shutdown

Wire into cmd/af-hub/main.go (read it by path; cmd/ is gitignored for find_files): after auditEmitter, the lease schema and the sandbox Service exist and before server.Start(), call StartGateway and log.Fatal on error
